start:
Hello, I'm Cleanify! How can I help you?
If this is your first time using me, please check out the help section <3

language.clearingOldMenu: Cleanify has been rebuilt from the ground up! Clearing the old menu...

forceJoin.prompt: To use Cleanify, please join our channel {channel} first, then tap the button below.
forceJoin.notJoinedYet: You haven't joined the channel yet. Join it, then tap "I've joined" again.

help.text:
How to use Cleanify:

1. Add me as an admin of your channel, with permission to delete messages.
2. Tap "Delete messages for me!" in the menu.
3. Forward me the first message you want deleted from your channel.
4. Forward me the last message you want deleted.
5. Check the estimated count and confirm. I'll delete both messages and everything in between.

Other things I can do:
• My channels: see the channels you manage with me.
• History: see your recent cleanups.
• /autocleanup: automatically delete channel messages older than a number of days you choose (/autocleanup off to stop). This only works for messages posted after I became an admin.
• /en or /fa: change the language.

errors.channelError: The message you sent isn't forwarded from a channel. Check the Help section for how it works :)
errors.differentChannelError: Those two messages are from different channels :/
errors.adminError: First, make me an admin of the channel with permission to delete messages. Then try again!
errors.deniedError: You're not an admin of that channel :/
errors.invalid: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Please choose from the menu!
errors.outOfOrder: The second message needs to be the same as or after the first one.

deleteFlow.firstMessagePrompt: Please forward the message you want me to start cleaning from:
deleteFlow.secondMessagePrompt: Now forward the message you want me to stop cleaning at:
deleteFlow.confirmPrompt: This will delete approximately {count} messages from {channel}. Are you sure?
deleteFlow.done: Done! I deleted {count} messages. Thanks for using Cleanify!
deleteFlow.failed: Something went wrong while deleting, so I stopped. Make sure I'm still an admin of the channel with permission to delete messages, then try again.
deleteFlow.failedPartway: Something went wrong after I'd processed about {count} messages, so I stopped. Make sure I'm still an admin of the channel with permission to delete messages, then try again.

channels.title: Your channels:
channels.empty: You haven't linked any channels yet. Forward a message from a channel to get started.

broadcast.unauthorized: You're not authorized to use this command.
broadcast.contentPrompt: Send me anything to broadcast — text, a photo, a video, or a document. It'll be sent exactly as you send it, formatting included.
broadcast.optionsPrompt: Ready to send to {count} recipients. Choose an audience and options below, then confirm.
broadcast.emptyAudience: No recipients match that audience — nothing was sent.

scheduledCleanup.chooseChannel: Which channel should auto-cleanup apply to?
scheduledCleanup.daysPrompt: After how many days should messages be automatically deleted? Send a whole number (e.g. 30).
scheduledCleanup.invalidDays: Please send a whole number of days, greater than 0 (e.g. 30).
scheduledCleanup.enabled: Auto-cleanup enabled: messages older than {days} days will be deleted automatically.
scheduledCleanup.disabled: Auto-cleanup disabled for all your channels.
scheduledCleanup.limitationNotice: Note: auto-cleanup only applies to messages posted from now on — I have no way to see the age of messages posted before you turned it on.
